title: Otis and the Pidgeon's Perfect Coo
markdown:
Dawn painted the town with pink and orange. Dewdrops glittered. Otis the otter bounced from his nook. "Morning's here!" he chirped, whiskers twitching. His bright eyes spotted Mei the heron by the fountain. "Ready for a splendid day, Mei?" he bounced, eager for adventure.

Mei nodded. "Indeed, Otis. A perfect morning for quiet observation."

Suddenly, Maestro Quill bustled in, his cello tucked under his arm. He adjusted his spectacles. "Today," he declared, "I shall give this square truly serious music!" He pictured a grand concert hall. This was no day for giggles.

Maestro Quill drew his bow. A powerful, solemn note bloomed. Otis and Mei paused, captivated. Then, from the clock tower, a soft coo sounded.

Coo.

It landed perfectly on the end of Maestro Quill's note. A curious beat.

Maestro Quill frowned and played another sad note.

Coo.

Again, the coo landed with precision. Otis’s grin stretched wider. Mei tilted her head. "That's Percy," she whispered, surprised.

Maestro Quill's music swelled. He poured passion into his performance.

COO.

The pigeon’s coo was louder this time, perfectly punctuating the music’s peak. It sounded like a witty remark.

Giggles rippled through the early risers. Otis snorted. Mei chuckled.

Maestro Quill’s shoulders stiffened. He tried a delicate passage.

Coo.

The pigeon’s coo arrived just as Maestro Quill’s bow paused, creating a hilarious silence. The crowd roared with laughter.

Maestro Quill’s face turned pink. He switched to a lively jig.

Coo-coo-COO.

Percy, it seemed, was enjoying himself. His rhythm was impeccable, a perfect counterpoint. He was the square's brilliant comic expert!

The entire square vibrated with laughter. Otis rolled on his back, kicking his feet. Mei had tears of amusement in her eyes. Maestro Quill, seeing the brilliant joy he was creating, finally stopped playing. He looked at Percy, then at the laughing faces.

A slow, genuine smile spread across his face. He picked up his bow again, winked at Otis and Mei, and began a new tune. It was still beautiful music, but this time, it had a playful bounce. As he played, Percy added his perfectly timed coos, turning the morning into a spectacular, side-splitting performance.

And with a grin, Otis bounced out of the square, ready for whatever came next! Today, he declared, was going to be AMAZING!
characters: Otis the otter, Mei the heron, Mr. Quill
